This neuron is weakly and diffusely tuned (tiny activation range, no consistent semantics): peaks land on ordinary mid-phrase continuation tokens — function words and word-piece continuations that complete a fixed collocation ("if you **are** pulled over", "incident **to** arrest", "mish**ap**", "NO **RES**ERVE") — while similar common function words ("able", "it", "the", "per") give the strongest negative values, so it likely encodes a low-level token-context feature rather than a nameable concept.
